question.text: An octahedral complex having molecular composition Co. $5 \mathrm{NH}_3. \mathrm{Cl}. \mathrm{SO}_4$ has two isomers A and B. The solution of A gives a white precipitate with $\mathrm{AgNO}_3$ solution and the solution of B gives white precipitate with $\mathrm{BaCl}_2$ solution. The type of isomerism exhibited by the complex is,

solution.text:
(A) complex is $\left[\mathrm{Co}\left(\mathrm{NH}_3\right)_5\left(\mathrm{SO}_4\right)\right] \mathrm{Cl}$
(B) complex is $\left[\mathrm{Co}\left(\mathrm{NH}_3\right)_5 \mathrm{Cl}\right] \mathrm{SO}_4$
Both $(\mathrm{A})$ and $(\mathrm{B})$ are Ionisation isomers.
